title: The Breach in the Wall
text: Something came up from the rift in the night and went back down again. Nobody saw it. It left a hole in the east wall wide enough for a cart, the stones not broken but bent softly outward like wax, along with a smell of wet earth that will not lift.

temptation.label: Let the masons take your quarry's best stone home.
temptation.text: The foreman offers to look the other way on a few loads, for a share of what they fetch.

triumph.text: The breach is sealed with stone stronger than the old wall.

holds.text: The breach is patched. Men watch it through the night.

falters.text: The patch holds badly. On moonless nights, things slip through.

calamity.text: The breach stands open. Every spear is needed on the walls, so the next expedition must wait.
